capability: 2 - transparent wrapper summaries (delegation to a known write sink)
frontend: joern-c2cpg v4.0.608 (frozen; TOOLCHAIN_FROZEN.md). NOTE: an earlier build under 4.0.462 was DISCARDED; 4.0.462 is not the frozen frontend.
design: General interprocedural model: infer that a user-defined callee DELEGATES a copy to a library write sink (memcpy family), writing its LENGTH argument into its DESTINATION parameter, from the callee BODY only (never the name). Additive: fires only on calls to summarized user-defined functions, which the frozen scanner never routes (verified disjoint from frozen v1 ops).
scope_separation: This capability is DELEGATION ONLY. A counted loop through an incremented pointer (ascii2ebcdic shape) is a DIFFERENT proof model with different obligations and is handled by cap_counted_loop_writer (see study/magma/counted_loop_writer_result.json). The two models are kept strictly separate and each asserts the other does not claim its shape.
soundness_gates: A summary is emitted only when exactly one (dest_param, length_param) delegation is implied; name-only, dest-local, non-parameter-length, and conflicting-sink callees get NO summary. Call-site capacity comes ONLY from an independently-established bare local fixed array; else additional_evidence_required. Routing reuses frozen v2.compare.
